items.title: ABYZOR Genesis adds FREE local AI for unlimited MIDI generation
items.excerpt: ABYZOR released a free local AI module for its Genesis MIDI generator plugin (macOS/Windows), generating melodies, basslines, chord progressions and arpeggios on-device that you edit and drag into your DAW.
items.note: Date+body via RSS (site shows bot-check page).

items.title: Backgrounds Creates Evolving Soundscapes From Your Keyword Prompts
items.excerpt: Sampleson Backgrounds turns keywords dragged onto a canvas into evolving cinematic soundscapes, using a semantic audio retrieval engine over 22,000 audio cells and 11,000 local embeddings, running locally with no tokens.
items.note: ML = semantic retrieval/embeddings, not a generative model; body never says 'AI'.

items.title: ElevenLabs' new v4 speech model supports more expression control and 90 languages
items.excerpt: ElevenLabs launched Eleven v4 and v4 Turbo, its most expressive speech models, with finer expression control, 90 languages and voice cloning from a 10-second clip.
items.note: Voice/vocal-adjacent, not a music model. Same launch also on ElevenLabs YouTube (th_tXR2QQ6U).

items.title: record your voice and turn it into ANYTHING.
items.excerpt: Suno demos a Suno Studio workflow: record your own voice and transform it into other instruments, electric guitar being 'just the start'.
items.note: Short promo; Suno Studio features published earlier (musictech suno-studio-2-0) but this voice-to-instrument demo is new.

items.title: Japanese Voice Actor Sues TikTok Over AI Voice Cloning
items.excerpt: A Japanese actor and anime voice talent, possibly the first in Japan to take a major platform to court over AI voice clones, has sued TikTok over videos allegedly using an AI clone of his voice.
items.note: OFF-LIST domain (digitalmusicnews.com); no on-list outlet covered it.

items.title: After a deepfake voice fooled her grandfather, this founder sprang into action
items.excerpt: DetectifAI is building AI models small enough to run on smartphones and flag deepfake voices in real time, after its founder's grandfather was scammed by a cloned voice.
items.note: Weak music hook (voice-clone detection); startup profile.

items.title: AI scammers are trying to use me
items.excerpt: Producer Andrew Huang warns followers that AI-driven scammers are impersonating him.
items.note: AI verified from the title only; page description is generic.

items.title: Does Coding Matter Anymore? Audio Programming in the AI Age | The Audio Programmer Meetup
items.excerpt: The Audio Programmer meetup asks whether hand-coding still matters for plugin and audio-software developers now that AI coding tools can build them.
items.note: AI verified from the title only. 12 days old, near the edge of the window.

items.title: Gemini 3.8 text-to-speech says hello
items.excerpt: Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash-Lite TTS are Google's most expressive audio models yet, letting users design custom character voices and direct scene dialogue across AI Studio, the Gemini API and Google Vids.
